This is the Cathedral of Shadows.



Our secret arts will surely aid
one who commands demons.


Demon Fusion...



fuses demons with one another
to create stronger demons.


It is also swayed by
the waxing and waning of the moon.


Sword Fusion...



fuses certain demons with items
to forge powerful swords (weapons).


Demon Summoning...



calls forth demons you have
recruited or created by fusion,


provided you pay
the MAG required.


That is all the Cathedral offers.
Now, what is your desire?
